message: Build a beautiful responsive landing page for Pollen modular desk organizers in index.html, inline CSS and vanilla JS, no build or network assets. Include a distinctive object illustration made with CSS, hero, three product cards, a small-space benefit section and FAQ. Primary CTA scrolls to products; cards show fictional prices without checkout. Make mobile navigation, visible focus and reduced motion work.

profile.care: Expressive objects and a working mobile page
profile.sections: use the sections in the brief
profile.platform: local Windows and Python 3 stdlib for CLI; modern desktop/mobile browser for web
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network, deployment or paid assets. Ask before scope or budget changes.
